label: prop:weak-equiv-invariance
title: Weak equivalence invariance of physical states
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0}, cosimplicial crossed groupoid structure (cosimplicial crossed groupoid), and substrate parameter q. Let \tau \colon \mathcal{A}_\infty \to \mathbb{C} be the vacuum state (vacuum state). A weak equivalence between brane levels n and m is a zigzag of coface and codegeneracy maps:

  \mathfrak{G}_n
  \xleftarrow{\sigma}
  \mathfrak{G}_{k_1}
  \xrightarrow{\delta}
  \cdots
  \xrightarrow{\delta}
  \mathfrak{G}_m.

For every observable a \in \mathcal{A}_\infty, the expectation value is invariant under weak equivalence:

  \tau\!\bigl(\iota_n(a|_n)\bigr)
  = 
  \tau\!\bigl(\iota_m(a|_m)\bigr),

where \iota_n \colon \Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)) \hookrightarrow \mathcal{A}_\infty is the canonical embedding and a|_n restricts a to level n. In particular, physical states (the GNS vectors of \tau) remain invariant under fluctuations of the substrate parameter q(p) across brane levels.
